description: Ctrl+H on F8 Sales OFFERS a real Item Invoice. The label matters as much as the behaviour: for a whole release this picker listed 'Item Invoice — not built', so a case asserting merely that three options appear would have passed against a dead end. Pinned as the exact ordered list, in Tally's own order, with only the genuinely-missing 'As Voucher' still carrying the not-built marker.
